title: Beyond toggling screens: How integrated contact centers and AI are redefining dealership ROI

body_markdown:
The automotive landscape is hyper-competitive, and customer expectations in sales and service have never been higher. When a customer calls a dealership, be it to check on a vehicle service status, inquire about a trade-in, or confirm a sales appointment, they expect an immediate, personalized, and informed response.


Yet behind the scenes, dealership staff are all too often bogged down by a legacy challenge: technology fragmentation. Agents are forced to juggle the phone system, a Dealer Management System (DMS), and a CRM simultaneously. This “swivel-chair” friction leads to longer handle times, missed follow-ups, inconsistent customer experiences, and lost revenue.


To solve this, RingCentral has announced a strategic partnership with NovelVox, introducing a unified approach that brings communication, CRM, and DMS capabilities into a single, seamless interface.


## The strategic imperative: Unifying the communications and operational stack


Through this partnership, RingCentral is embedding NovelVox’s[Agent Accelerator](https://www.novelvox.com/unified-agent-desktops/ringcentral-agent-desktop/) and[CCIP](https://www.novelvox.com/ccip/ringcentral/) solutions into **RingCX, RingEX, AI Receptionist (AIR), AI Representative (AIR Pro), and RingCentral Contact Center (RCCC)** .


For automotive groups, this delivers native, out-of-the-box integration with the core platforms driving dealership operations—including **CDK Global, Cox Automotive, and Reynolds & Reynolds.**


Instead of treating phone interactions as isolated events requiring manual post-call data entry, the partnership establishes a real-time data bridge between the communications platform and the system of record.


Key operational capabilities delivered to the desktop:


- **Instant customer & vehicle recognition:** Incoming calls automatically pop the exact customer profile, vehicle service history, and sales record before the agent even says hello.
- **Real-time appointment syncing:** Service and sales appointments are scheduled and updated inside the DMS in real time, eliminating double-entry and scheduling errors.
- **Automated workflow & CRM updates:** Follow-ups, interaction notes, and status changes are completed during the call within a unified interface.


##


## From conversation to execution: The role of Agentic Voice AI


What makes this integration truly transformative is how it enables actionable AI. Unifying data flows creates the foundation required for RingCentral’s Agentic Voice AI solutions to operate securely and effectively within business logic.


Customer interactions are no longer just about the conversation with the customer, but what outcomes are driven from it, such as a test drive or service appointment, and capturing those actions across the systems dealerships rely on. For a dealership, that’s the difference between a customer service representative manually updating a customer’s service history and an agent (or an AI representative) actually scheduling the appointment or updating the record while still on the call.


Routine inbound inquiries—such as appointment confirmations, status checks, or parts inquiries—can now be resolved end-to-end by voice AI agents capable of reading and writing directly back to the DMS without human intervention. The aim is AI that can act inside the rules a business runs on, moving a task forward in the system of record in real time rather than leaving the follow-through to a human.


## The bottom-line impact for dealership leadership


For dealerships managing high call volumes across multiple store locations, this partnership translates directly into operational efficiency and measurable ROI:


- **Reduced average handle time (AHT):** Eliminating app-switching saves valuable seconds on every call, increasing contact center capacity.
- **Elimination of dropped follow-ups:** Capturing updates during the interaction guarantees accurate CRM tracking and higher lead conversion.
- **Elevated customer lifetime value (LTV):** Frictionless service interactions foster long-term loyalty across both sales and service departments.
- **Scalable operations:** Voice AI handles repetitive call volume, allowing staff to focus on high-value sales consulting and complex service needs.


## Driving the future of automotive retail


As automotive retail continues its digital transformation, dealership success will belong to organizations that eliminate operational friction and empower both human agents and AI to act decisively in real time.
